queries.query: 帮我设计一个 agent 循环，每一步的上下文预算和 token 上限都要写出来。
这个 agent 老是重复调用同一个工具，帮我加卡死检测和停止条件。
给这个 agent 设计工具 schema，包括描述、分页字段和错误信息该写什么。
我们准备给 agent 加一个 MCP server，先帮我评估工具怎么切分。
帮我判断这些步骤哪些该拆成子 agent，哪些直接放在主循环里跑。
这个 agent 的 eval 通过率谁都说不出来，帮我搭一套 eval 套件并报出 n/N。
Design the tool-call loop for an agent that triages support tickets: per-step token budget, caps and stop results.
Design the tool schemas for an MCP server over our issue tracker: descriptions, error messages, pagination.
Decide whether these four research slices should run as subagents or inline in the main loop.
Build the eval suite for our agent and report the pass rate per configuration over three runs.
Review an agent someone else wrote: its caps, state registry, tool errors and eval coverage.
The agent calls a Kubernetes operator to reconcile; design what the agent's tool surface should look like.
帮我把订单服务的 REST 接口改成游标分页，给出资源、状态码和 openapi.yaml。
我的 controller 里 finalizer 卡住不释放，帮我排查 reconcile 逻辑。
调研 LangGraph 在生产环境的成熟度，带上 GitHub release 和 issue 的引用。
这个 prompt 太长，帮我压缩到 200 token 以内并保持指令完整。
帮我训练一个文本分类模型，数据集在本地 CSV 里。
把这个 JSON 配置文件转成 YAML。
Design the REST contract for our billing service, including pagination and error codes.
My operator's reconcile loop keeps requeueing; help me debug the finalizer path.
Research whether this vector database is production-ready, citing releases and open issues.
Rewrite this system prompt so the model always answers in the JSON shape we need.
Our fine-tuning run plateaus at 0.6 accuracy; tell me what to change in the dataset.
Convert this CSV file to JSON, one object per row.
